title: The Best of the Bunch
body: I've tried similar apps, but this one easily tops them all. It's simple to use, flexible in making changes, and clear in helping to reach your habit goals. If there is one thing I would add, it would be to be able to erase all previous progress goals without having to retype all the habits again. Sometimes after a period of missing my goals, I'd like to start over again. Other than that, this is one of the only apps that I use everyday. Kudos to the dev!

title: Good app
body:
It's a well designed app. The only tricky thing about it all is that you can enter as many habits as you would like to change. In reality changing more than one habit at a time is really hard, therefore it would be nice if the app was more built around that principle. (For example being able to enter a new habit when you were successfull with the first habit for 30 days)
Still though I think this app is the nicest app in this category, I've tried a few.
